title: Godot freezes when right-clicking the file system and scene view
body:
### Tested versions

From 4.1 to 4.4.1, I have not used earlier versions

### System information

Godot v4.4.stable - Windows 11 (build 22621) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Laptop GPU (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6590) - Intel(R) Core(TM) Ultra 5 125H (18 threads)

### Issue description

Godot freezes when right-clicking the file system and scene view. The right-click window pops up, but there is no content. Then the system starts to freeze. I open the task manager with difficulty and see that the GPU usage is close to 100%. It may get better after a while, but if I try to right-click again, it will probably freeze again, and even cause expolrer to crash and black screen until I restart the system.  
  
I can't provide relevant pictures because it is difficult to open the screenshot tool when the computer freezes.  

Some additional details: While GPU utilization is high, the process that's using the most GPU is usually not Godot, but the currently displayed application.  
  

Godot seems to default to using my NVIDIA graphics card starting with version 4.4, but the integrated graphics card that's rendering the display is the one that's using the most GPU.
I don't understand English, the translator translated these contents

### Steps to reproduce

I don't know if this problem is common. At least I asked in a Chinese community and no one said they had meeted a similar situation.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

Write code for a while, right-click the file system (which is easier to appear than the scene view in my use process), and it will appear
